description: This file defines a data access layer class 'UserRepository' for interacting with 'User' data in a database using SQLAlchemy ORM. It includes methods for retrieving users by ID and email, creating new users, and listing users with pagination.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: A repository class providing methods to perform CRUD operations and queries related to users in the database.

methods.name: None __init__(self, session: Session)
methods.description: Initializes the UserRepository with a SQLAlchemy session.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_by_id(self, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a User by their ID.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_by_email(self, email: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a User by their email address.

methods.name: User create(self, email: str, name: Optional[str], password_hash: str)
methods.description: Creates a new User with specified email, name, and password hash.

methods.name: Tuple[List[User],int] list_paginated(self, limit: int, offset: int)
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of users along with the total count.

ctags.name: create
ctags.pattern: /^    def create(self, email: str, name: Optional[str], password_hash: str) -> User:$/
ctags.signature: (self, email: str, name: Optional[str], password_hash: str)

ctags.name: list_paginated
ctags.pattern: /^    def list_paginated(self, limit: int, offset: int) -> Tuple[List[User], int]:$/
